claim.text: Notion 支持多人同时编辑同一页面：官方说明称你可以与不限人数的人同时编辑同一页面。

review.reason: The bound evidence_terms value includes the verbatim line 'You can edit the same page at the same time with an unlimited number of people,' which directly supports simultaneous editing with unlimited people. The claim's '官方说明称' framing is consistent with this documented source text.

claim.text: Notion 的评论可见性：页面顶部的时间记录可显示谁在何时做了哪些更改，并且你也能看到人们在哪里留下了评论。

review.reason: The bound evidence_terms value includes 'Click 🕘 at the top of the page to see who made what changes and when' and 'You can also see where people have left comments,' supporting both the time-record change visibility and comment-location visibility subclaims.

claim.text: Notion 的“Can edit”权限级别：选择该访问级别的人可以编辑页面内容，但不能将页面分享给他人。

review.reason: The bound evidence_terms value and quote q0 state that the 'Can edit' access level lets people edit page content but not share the page with others, matching the claim exactly.

claim.text: Confluence 支持实时协作编辑：你和最多29名队友可以同时实时编辑同一页面，更改会自动保存和同步，使所有正在编辑的人看到相同内容。

review.reason: The bound evidence_terms value and quote q2 state 'You and up to 29 teammates can edit a page together in real time in Confluence. Changes save and sync automatically so that everyone editing sees the same thing.' This matches the claim's subclaims: real-time collaborative editing, you plus up to 29 teammates, automatic save/sync, and all editors seeing the same content.

claim.text: Confluence 支持在编辑页面时添加行内评论；只有处于该编辑会话中的人可以查看、回复和解决这些评论，页面发布后任何未解决的评论可被页面查看者看到。

review.reason: The bound evidence_terms value and quote q0 state 'Inline comments can be added while editing a page. Only those in your editing session can see, reply to, and resolve the comments. Once the page has been published, any unresolved comments can be seen by page viewers.' This matches the claim's subclaims about inline comments during editing, visibility/reply/resolve limited to the editing session, and unresolved comments visible to page viewers after publication.

claim.text: 在 Confluence 中创建页面或博客文章，需要拥有该空间的“Add content”权限。

review.reason: The bound evidence_terms value and quote q1 state 'To create a page or blog post, you need the Add content permissions for that space.' This directly supports the claim that creating a page or blog post in Confluence requires the 'Add content' permission for that space.

claim.text: Superhuman Docs 支持在同一文档中进行实时共同编辑和线程化评论，团队可以在文档内创建、编辑并给出反馈。

review.reason: The bound evidence_terms value and quote q1 state that with Superhuman Docs, teams can create, edit, and give feedback in the same document, and that Docs makes this possible with real-time co-editing and threaded comments. This directly supports real-time co-editing and threaded comments in the same document, with teams creating, editing, and giving feedback.

claim.text: 在 Superhuman Docs 中，可以以几种不同方式向文档的画布和表格添加评论。

review.reason: The bound evidence_terms value and quote q2 state: 'You can add comments to the canvas and tables of a doc in a few different ways,' which directly supports adding comments to the canvas and tables in a few different ways.

claim.text: 在 Superhuman Docs 中，Full access 权限面向需要帮助管理文档的可信协作者，除编辑权限外还包含其他管理能力。

review.reason: The bound evidence_terms value and quote q0 state: 'Full access | This permission is intended for trusted collaborators who need to help manage the doc. In addition to edit access, they can…' This supports that Full access is for trusted collaborators who need to help manage the doc and includes capabilities beyond edit access.

原文：- Can edit content : This permission level is only found on database pages. People with this level of access can create and edit pages within the database, and edit property values for those pages. However, they will not be able to change the structure of the database and its properties, views, sorts, or filters. Learn more about databases here →；完整条件：Sometimes you'll want to share a page with only select members of your workspace — like a meeting doc for 1:1s with your manager, or notes for a small project team. To share a page with specific people:
原文：Notion is built for collaboration, so there are many ways to share your work with other people. Our permission levels ensure that your collaborators access your content exactly the way you want them to.；完整条件：Notion is built for collaboration, so there are many ways to share your work with other people. Our permission levels ensure that your collaborators access your content exactly the way you want them to.
Jump to FAQs
Select Share at the top of any page to:；Sometimes you'll want to share a page with only select members of your workspace — like a meeting doc for 1:1s with your manager, or notes for a small project team. To share a page with specific people:
原文：- Can create : This permission level is only found on database pages and is available on Business and Enterprise plans. People with this level of access can create new pages within the database, but can’t view or edit existing pages they haven't been individually granted access to. This is useful when you want contributors to submit entries (like IT tickets, task requests, or form responses) without being able to see or modify other people's entries.；完整条件：Sometimes you'll want to share a page with only select members of your workspace — like a meeting doc for 1:1s with your manager, or notes for a small project team. To share a page with specific people:
原文：You can edit the same page at the same time with an unlimited number of people.；完整条件：Notion has several features designed to improve and increase the velocity of communication with your team — whether you're all editing the same page or working across time zones.
You can edit the same page at the same time with an unlimited number of people.
- Their profile photos will show you where they're looking or working on the page.
- Edits and comments made by everyone will appear to you instantly.
原文：- Full access : People with full access to a page can edit any of the content it contains and share the page with anyone they want.；完整条件：For every person, group, or teamspace you share a page with, you can assign a different permission level. This helps to keep private information private and gives you granular, precise control over your work.
Here are the different permission levels in Notion:
- Full access : People with full access to a page can edit any of the content it contains and share the page with anyone they want.；Sometimes you'll want to share a page with only select members of your workspace — like a meeting doc for 1:1s with your manager, or notes for a small project team. To share a page with specific people:
原文：- Content added is highlighted in blue.
  - Gray strikethrough shows what's been removed.
  - You can also see where people have left comments.；完整条件：- Edits and comments made by everyone will appear to you instantly.
- Click 🕘 at the top of the page to see who made what changes and when.
  - Content added is highlighted in blue.
